---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible scheduling, lifecycle, or integration problem
---

Describe the expected and observed behavior.

Provide version, Python/Slurm versions, a minimal sanitized task/config and the
relevant decision/event. Include snapshot age and whether the job was submitted.
Remove tokens, SSH details, private paths and research artifacts.

Explain impact and any workaround. Do not run a disruptive cluster reproduction.
